section.title: Key not detected

li.p: The EV button cannot be operated due to a problem with the EV button system
You could start the vehicle by pressing the EV button once more.
If the warning message is displayed each time you press the EV button, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: Place smart key on emergency start position and press EV button.

li.p: The EV button is pressed while the “Key not detected” warning message is displayed
The brake switch fuse is disconnected
You need to replace the fuse with a new one before starting the vehicle.
If that is not possible, you can start the vehicle by pressing the EV button for 10 seconds in the POWER ON or DRIVE READY position.

section.title: The steering wheel heater is off
section.p: When you turn off the steering wheel heater

section.title: Charge immediately. Power limited
section.p: When the battery temperature is extremely low in winter, the battery temperature optimization is conducted for normal driving conditions.
The optimization time may vary depending on the battery temperature and charging conditions.

section.title: Power limited due to low EV battery temperature. Charge battery
section.p: If the high voltage battery level and temperature is too low, the power may be limited. When the warning message is displayed, please charge the vehicle immediately.

li.p: Some driving information stored in the trip computer resets if the battery is disconnected.
If any of the following conditions occurs, the mileage and days may be incorrect.
The battery cable is disconnected.
The battery is discharged.
If sunroof open warning is displayed in the cluster, the Driving Information message may not be displayed.
To set the charging time and/or climate time, refer to Navigation Quick Reference Guide.
If the icy road warning appears while driving, you should drive more attentively and safely refraining from over-speeding, rapid acceleration, sudden braking or sharp turning, etc.
